name: Barbarian audit: Breaking Morale spell modifier reaches its target spells (#1104)
contract: Audit report #1104 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation.

steps.label: before: 560934 has no modifier for op 14
681473 op 14 flat -15 reaches 560934 (mask selects 2 Barbarian spell(s))
681473 op 0 percent +25 reaches 501027 (mask selects 29 Barbarian spell(s))
